segments.sn48.70:1.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci supaṇṇānaṃ rukkhā, kūṭasimbalī [koṭasimbali (syā. kaṃ.)] tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.sn48.70:1.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāya.
segments.sn48.70:1.4: Saddhindriyaṃ, bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati … pe … paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiyo dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn48.70:1.5: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, ye keci supaṇṇānaṃ rukkhā, kūṭasimbalī tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati;
segments.sn48.70:1.6: evameva kho, bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhiyā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ – bodhāyā”ti.
segments.sn48.70:2.3: Dve phalā caturo rukkhā, vaggo tena pavuccatīti.
